Kempt_Head.reason: The nearly straight western face makes a unique along-shore extremum ambiguous. A whole Boularderie centroid was also not adopted because no complete audited source exterior was produced. The separate, clearly closed Fraser Point island was measured instead.

Belfry_extension.reason: The source labels Belfry Point and McCuish Gut. The headland/channel/barrier configuration was not resolved to a shared exact shore point. No southern-extension accuracy claim follows.

White_Point.reason: The source depicts a stippled rocky extension and the modern geometry includes separated/intertidal bodies. A shared coastline definition was not established. Green Island supplies a separate identifiable coastal check.
